narrative.overview: Tideline is an operating interface for frequent money entries. Users choose between Hiện tại and the tactile Sổ tay style; four palettes in each style rotate with the spending cycle.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers and actions stay prominent across styles.
Palette changes mark a new cycle without relocating controls.
Sổ tay gives surfaces, fields, and buttons restrained physical depth.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Positive balance remains green and deficit remains red in all eight themes.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: Depth clarifies which areas are a surface, an input, or an action; it does not compete with money values.

dos: Do preserve readable contrast and semantic surplus/deficit meaning in every palette.
Do show the style choice and current cycle theme together in Settings.
Do keep form controls and navigation in consistent positions across styles.
donts: Don't let material lighting reduce the contrast of amount text or chart data.
Don't change the spending calculation or transaction history when the theme changes.
